okay so i went to a catholic school from preschool to eighth grade. and i LOVED everything about it- everything except the faith aspect. i only began to realize that i was being forced into the entire thing after the long process leading to my eventual confirmation

this went on for weeks. weeks then turned into months... and months into years. the cycle went on for three years. it had started around my freshman year of high school and continued throughout my entire high school career.
now, i’m 18 years old. i’m technically an adult. i go to university, i live away from home, i have a job...
now, i’m 18 years old. i’m technically an adult. i go to university, i live away from home, i have a job...

i was never given an option. i was thrust into catholicism at a VERY young age ( four years old, to be exact) with no way to think for myself. as i grew up, things like the 10 commandments were drilled into my head. i went to church weekly at school. i prayed at mealtimes, i
went to confession monthly. i prayed daily, i sang at masses.. i was the perfect catholic. i got confirmed, and took on the middle name colette.

going into high school, i knew only three people. and i didn’t have any classes with them. so i found two girls i knew from my volleyball team and CLUNG to them. i followed them around everywhere. i copied everything they did. everything about them, i copied.
then, in my senior year of high school, i was diagnosed with depression and anxiety. suddenly, all the anger came back full force. and it was even worse.
everything just snapped together, and i started piecing together all the missing gaps in my beliefs. eventually, i came to the conclusion that i simply wasn’t religious anymore.
